top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation is a new chemical modality with an explicit mechanism (ligand and linker design, ternary-complex cooperativity, cereblon as the thalidomide target), independently reproduced in many laboratories. The credit divides on a defensible line between the PROTAC concept (Crews, Deshaies) and the mechanistic explanation of molecular glues (Handa), and four members name the same three people. The lack of an approved degrader and the exclusion of Ciulli, Ito, Gray, Sakamoto and Kim are real weaknesses, but no rival has a cleaner combination of originality and agreed names. Ionizable lipid nanoparticles rank next on maturity, ahead of the two-part lipid-plus-base-editing proposal because base editing is less mature.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Lund colleagues Somfai and Sparr sit on the committee, but there is no direct tie to any proposed laureate.
